/bin/zsh -lc "date -Iseconds && shasum -a 256 outputs/v2/change-request.md outputs/project-state.json && python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('.')
for version in ('v0','v1'):
    ver=json.loads((root/f'outputs/{version}/verification.json').read_text())
    checks=[]
    for rel, expected in ver['artifact_hashes_sha256'].items():
        checks.append((rel, hashlib.sha256((root/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected))
    print(version, 'all_recorded_hashes_match=', all(ok for _,ok in checks), 'checked=',len(checks))
image_suffixes={'.png','.jpg','.jpeg','.webp','.tif','.tiff','.psd','.ai','.pdf'}
files=[p for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p.suffix.lower() in image_suffixes]
print('visual_files=',len(files))
print('taobao_named_targets=',[p.as_posix() for p in files if any(k in p.name.lower() for k in ('taobao','淘宝','main-image','main_image'))])
PY"

import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
